The following events took place in '''12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], under the assumed name "[[Jaster Mereel]]," was exiled from [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] for the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of the [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protector]] [[Lenovar]].<ref name="erc">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
*[[Regional Sector Number Four's All-Human Free-For-All]] was held on [[Jubilar/Legends|Jubilar]] and won by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref><ref name="Last One Standing">''[[The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett]]'' states that "''fifteen years passed''" between the events on [[Jubilar/Legends|Jubilar]] and the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which took place in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref>
*[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Hallolar Voors]] on Jubilar.<ref name="Last One Standing" />
*[[Colony Two]] was constructed on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]].<ref name="TPS" />
*Han Solo won the [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] championship of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] a second time.<ref name="TPS" />

*[[Alexandra Winger]] on [[Janara III]]<ref name="A Glimmer of Hope">{{JournalCite|1|A Glimmer of Hope}}</ref><ref name="Shades of Gray">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/shadesofgray/index.html|text="Shades of Gray"|int=Shades of Gray|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>
*[[Duno Dree]]<ref name="DoB">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'' gives Duno Dree an age of seventeen at the time of the [[mission to Dorlo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Rebel Agent'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Using simple math a date of [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]] can be surmised as Dree's date of birth.</ref>
*[[Teneniel Djo]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] {{Circa}}<ref name="Courtship">During the events of ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', set in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Djo was "''no more than eighteen years old, perhaps twenty.''"</ref>
